storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: He is but a giant. His silhouette awing, his power indestructible. His weapon a colossal blade that no one else can lift. His victories, gleaming like oiled fur on the blade's fang, nourished by countless wars and savage sacrifices. His prize, a mountain of heads severed from his enemies and kin, crowned only by his own head on top.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
On April 2, A.F.3@2, a temple remain in the Ashdod region was vandalized.

As the only one who had university education, I, a mere visitor, was invited by the regional administrator to participate in the architectural assessment of the ruins. Haha, I should never let them know that my "university" isn't quite what it seems.

On the afternoon of April 3, I entered the center of the temple. Ancient Semitics used it as a place of worship, and their pagan belief once flourished among the pillars before lost in history.

Yet what appeared before me was a sculpture that could be mistaken by no one. I clearly knew that the folds on its clothes should indicate the texture of striped linen.

However, its both hands were broken, its head severed from the body, and its lower limbs shattered on the threshold. Mucilage covered everywhere like the trace of a sticky slug. Upon inspection, there were few peculiar scratches buried within, accompanied by a giant, webbed footprint.

The pagan belief may still circulate nearby, but a formal investigation is not urgently necessary. I will extend my stay in the Ashdod region.

Fin@1@2sen, "An account of a trip around five cities of the Philistines"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Goliath is tyrannical and ruthless, but his power is undeniable. According to Miss Erica's battle records, his brutal brawn can no doubt guarantee his advantage even in isolated and vicious situations. I believe that Goliath does not care about the level of his partner's ability just because no one can hold a candle to him in his world.

However, everytime Goliath faces Miryam, fear always seeps from his eyes uncontrollably. It's hard to imagine what kind of existence would evoke such awe from this despotic ruler and brutal former-king.

Additionally, he has shown unusual concern for Miss Murphy. Sometimes he was witnessed to wander around the university's surrounding maze, maybe waiting for Murphy to return from her mission. Sometimes he would distantly observe Murphy's condition, seemingly worrying about possible injuries during her tasks.

Miss Peaslee also notices this. Once she said to me half-jokingly, "Hey, don't you think he's trying to be an ordinary father?"

"Observation record from an intern researcher"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
A scar jagged across his neck. A declaration of death for his people, while a coronation of majestic power for him.

When exile marks his failure, bitterness drown his breath; when despration hollows for surrender, and tides clamor for sacrificehe prays to the God for the power. His transcendent power.

Thus the God's apostle accepts his prayer, severing his head as an offering.

Thus the God's apostle acknowledges his prayer, emplacing the remnants of immortal on his exposed cervical spine.

Thus the God's apostle answers his prayer, leading him into the sanctum of eternity.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Beheading death's cold embrace, he survived and transformed. The glitter on his blade fades. The mask of apostle conceals his savage expression.

He did revere instinctively when that miracle manifested. But no god could capture his fear, and no cult could earn his faith.

A giant should not yield to others. A warrior should not lower his head.

His past already wreathed in dust, his war still longing for final triumph. The desire for conquest run through his veins, etching into bones like a sigil bearing the bestowed power. Perhaps, one day, death will end his dominion. Perhaps, one day, he will rise to the sole supremacy.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Remember my name, Goliath. This name is destined to trample upon humanity's insignificant history.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Interesting... Aren't you afraid I'll tear you into fragments and feed you to the fish once I gain power?

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Time to give this a try. Hmph. How about cutting the throat of a few weaklings first?

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: You do work hard to be a Keeper worthy of me, I see.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Very well... You have a keen eye for recognizing capable people.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Don't get carried away. Sometimes, the line between the noble and the lowly is but a single step.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Not bad. One step closer to tearing off that hypocrite woman's veil.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: I'm regaining my strength... Next, I'll claim the dominion that is rightfully mine!

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: The reason to be stronger? In my tribe, the weak are stripped bare, their heads shorn, and subjected to the most vile disgrace imaginable—the cost of weakness is not one that everyone can bear.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: This moment has finally arrived, after thousands of years of waiting... I am the Philistines' one and only ruler!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Companions? Hmph... I don't need any. I won't be weighed down by the same burden twice.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: I must remind you that our cooperation hinges entirely on your power. Should your power wane, this contract will immediately cease, and I will sever your head without any hesitation.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I see the light in your eyes. That desire, that ambition... it burns. Admit it, mortal! We're the same kind.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Do you know the Albatross? They bravely confront the storms, but once banished to the ground, surrounded by mockery, those giant, drooping wings ironically become a pathetic hindrance. Anyway, this story means nothing... It just came to mind as I feel very relaxed to be with you—just casual chat.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Perhaps the times have truly changed. Nowadays, even the weak can surmount the reefs, command the waves, and become the king of the sky. Mortal, I await the day you rewrite history. It will be my honor to become the mighty blade in your hand!

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Tremble before these muscles... They are always ready to sever your head.

daily.title: Chat: About Murphy
daily.content: Oh, our puppet princess is weeping again. Is the milk bottle not fitting, or is the lullaby not soothing enough?

daily.title: Chat: About Miryam
daily.content: A woman who would sail across the ocean alone isn't always a divine being. She's just as likely mad. I mistook Miryam for a goddess, and that was a stupid mistake.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Have you ever had D-Slime forced into your veins? The black goo coils around your heart like a viper, and then... boom! Your body explodes into a warm, pulpy mess. Disgusting, but effective.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Hmph, a haven for the weak to huddle together.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I love grilled octopus, boiled octopus, fried octopus... Some say I'm committing blasphemy. Ha, my apologies, but octopus is simply too delicious, hahaha!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Gods? Only fools would entrust their lives to such intangible beings. Instead of betting your life on the so-called gods, you'd be better off focusing on how to become stronger.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: With such a frail body, it's too much to ask you to be my companion. You are simply too weak; you must intensify your training. Come, I'll take you to the academy's sports club and open your eyes.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: The dice is cast. Now, finish this swiftly!

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Well done. Time to celebrate the victory with a barrel of rum!

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: The taste of being exiled and cast adrift at sea... Once was enough.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: The raging tide of vengeance never ceases!

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Nothing compares to the power of a Giant!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Behold! This is the power the Philistines rely on!
